hooks.name: Offer to generate detector when new trace folder appears

action.prompt: A new gesture trace was saved to fixtures/. If there are now 3 or more traces for the same gesture name (the part before the underscore and number), generate a detector function in packages/kit/src/gestures.ts that matches that gesture, and add a test to tests/gestures.test.ts that uses those traces as fixtures. Follow the existing detector patterns. Run the tests when done.
